description:
Located within a mature and well established residential development, this well maintained three bedroom semi detached home offers brights and spacious accommodation in a highly convenient location. Within walking distance of Mullingar town centre, the train station and a host of local amenities, the property also enjoys easy access to the N4 motorway, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, families or investors alike.
The accommodation opens with solid timber flooring leading into a welcoming entrance hall with timber flooring. The spacious sitting room features solid timber floor and an open fireplace. The kitchen/dining are is fitted with ample storage units, laminate floor and enjoys access to the rear garden.
Upstairs, the carpet landing leads to three generously proportioned bedrooms, all benefitting from fitted storage and laminate flooring. The family bathroom is fitted with a bath and a shower, wash hand basin and WC, with tiled walls completing the finish.
Externally, the property enjoys a private rear garden with mature shrubs and planting, together with a block-built garden shed providing excellent storage. To the front, there is ample off-street parking and a pleasant setting within this quiet family-friendly estate.
Additional features include oil-fired central heating, spacious accommodation throughout and an excellent location close to schools, shops, leisure facilities and transport links.
This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-located family home in a mature residential setting. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this property has to offer.
